**All 12 people are deferred in the lowest-cost plan, so the car makes no trips.** This is the best result under the stated cost rules, but it may not be acceptable operationally.

**Network constraints**
- **Evacuation point:** Jwalamukhi shelter is the only valid drop-off. Dupcheshwar temple has not been designated, so drop-offs there don't count.
- **Usable roads:** The only route is Jwalamukhi – Dupcheshwar (12) – Gosaikunda (31) – Trishuli (17) – Thakre (19).
- **Distances from the shelter:** Trishuli market is 60 minutes away and Thakre market is 79 minutes away.
- **Likhu school:** Both roads to it have washed away, so it can't be reached. The 4 injured people and the child must be deferred, costing 4×80 + 60 = 380.

**Options for the 7 adults at Trishuli and Thakre**

Deferring an adult costs 20, so a full car of 4 avoids only 80 in penalties.

| Option | Driving | Penalties | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Defer all 7 | 0 | 7×20 = 140 | **140** |
| Rescue 4 from Trishuli, defer 3 | 120 | 3×20 = 60 | 180 |
| Rescue 3 from Thakre, defer 4 | 158 | 4×20 = 80 | 238 |
| Rescue 4 from Thakre or Trishuli on a single Thakre trip, defer 3 | 158 | 3×20 = 60 | 218 |
| Rescue all 7 (two trips) | 120 + 158 = 278 | 0 | 278 |

Each round trip costs more driving time than the penalties it avoids, so deferring all 7 adults is cheapest.

**Total cost:** 380 + 140 = 520

<plan>
defer likhu-school injured 4
defer likhu-school child 1
defer thakre-market adult 3
defer trishuli-market adult 4
</plan>

**For the coordinators**
- **Rescuing some adults:** Bringing the 4 Trishuli shopkeepers to the shelter would add only 40 to the total cost (560 instead of 520). This may be worth doing if the car has no other tasks.
- **Reaching Likhu school:** The injured people and the child are the most urgent group, but a car can't reach them. The next wave may need a boat, a helicopter or a bridge repair.

COST: 520
